description: Size the extra hardware a Celestia Fibre node needs on top of a validator, from the validator's share of voting power: storage rows, disk, sustained ingress, monthly inbound traffic, RAM and the uplink to order. A port of the Celestia Foundation's public Fibre calculator as Pulse implements it, calibrated to Mocha. The november_preview throughput is an UNCONFIRMED estimate, not an official Celestia figure. A sizing calculator, not live network data; the output links to the Pulse page that lists the servers for this plan.

bandwidth_allowance_pct.description: Share of your uplink you let Fibre use; sizes the recommended port (default 20%)

retention_hours.description: Blob retention window the store must cover (calculator default 4 h)

stake_share_pct.description: Your share of consensus voting power in percent, e.g. 1 for 1%

throughput.description: current = Mocha-level; november_preview = unconfirmed 15x estimate for a possible 2.2 GB/s target

name: size_fibre_node
